name: ZCA_AI_DATASUFFICIENCY_REPORTS
description: To persists the data sufficiency check results of customer data as part of the CX intelligent features on-boarding automation.

columns.name: DATA_SUFFICIENCY_REPORT_ID
columns.description: This column stores the unique code for a configuration property in a given context.

columns.name: DATA_SUFFICIENCY_JOB_ID
columns.description: This is FK to the ZCA_AI_DATASUFFICIENCY_JOBS table

columns.name: FEATURE_ID
columns.description: This columns stores the unique code to identify a feature.

columns.name: FEATURE_OWNER
columns.description: This columns stores the data intelligence feature owner details.

columns.name: FEATURE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This columns stores the enabled status of the feature.

columns.name: SELECTED_TO_ENABLE_FLAG
columns.description: This columns stores whether the feature is selected to enable status.

columns.name: REPORT_STATUS
columns.description: This columns stores the data sufficiency report status.

columns.name: DATA_SUFFICIENCY_TOTAL_SCORE
columns.description: This columns stores the data sufficiency score computed for an intelligence feature by the feature specific data sufficiency check APIs.

columns.name: DATA_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
columns.description: This columns stores the data sufficiency level for an intelligence feature.

columns.name: DATA_SUFFICIENCY_REPORT
columns.description: This columns stores any additional report generated by the data sufficiency check APIs.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_METADATA
columns.description: This columns stores any additional metadata required for the feature on-boarding UI flow.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
